title: Function calling in the OpenAI API
before: Developers coaxed structured tool calls out of models with prompt templates and regex parsing.
problem: Free-text tool calls are unreliable to parse and break silently.
breakthrough: Declare functions with a JSON schema; the model returns a structured call the runtime can execute.
why: It turned agents from a research pattern into ordinary application development.
next: MCP standardised the connection between models and tools a year later.
inherits: Structured tool calling as a basic API feature.
